name: Jock Landale
comment: Landale (hip) won't play Wednesday in Oklahoma City.

name: Kingston Flemings
comment: Flemings (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.

name: Asa Newell
comment: Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: CJ McCollum
comment: McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

name: Mouhamed Gueye
comment: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: Henri Veesaar
comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

name: Grayson Allen
comment: Allen (concussion-like symptoms) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Lakers.

name: Kon Knueppel
comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

name: Dennis Schroder
comment: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

name: Tobe Awaka
comment: Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Nets.

name: Caleb Wilson
comment: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Peyton Watson
comment: Watson (back) is out for Wednesday's game versus Memphis.

name: Jaylon Tyson
comment: Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Memphis.

name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
comment: Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

name: Evan Mobley
comment: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

name: Tobi Lawal
comment: Lawal is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors due to tightness in his right groin.

name: Sergio de Larrea
comment: De Larrea (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

name: Dereck Lively II
comment: Lively (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

name: Tarik Biberovic
comment: Biberovic (heel) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

name: Julian Strawther
comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

name: Cade Cunningham
comment: Cunningham (knee) won't play in Wednesday's game against New Orleans.

name: Taurean Prince
comment: Prince (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans.

name: Ronald Holland II
comment: Holland (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans.

name: Duncan Robinson
comment: Robinson will be re-evaluated in one week due to a left quadriceps strain, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.

name: Jalen Duren
comment: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

name: Al Horford
comment: Horford (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks, but will play Thursday against the Grizzlies, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.

name: Brandon Williams
comment: Williams (hamstring) has progressed to on-court activities and will be re-evaluated Saturday.

name: Stephen Curry
comment: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Kristaps Porzingis
comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

name: Moses Moody
comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Jimmy Butler III
comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Alperen Sengun
comment: Sengun (eye) will not return to Wednesday's game against the Pacers, Will Guillory of The Athletic reports.

name: Clint Capela
comment: Capela (ankle) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Indiana.

name: Andrew Nembhard
comment: Nembhard (hip) won't play in Wednesday's game against the Rockets, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

name: Braden Smith
comment: Smith suffered a right ankle sprain during Wednesday's game against the Wizards, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

name: Tyrese Haliburton
comment: Head coach Rick Carlisle said Tuesday that Haliburton (hamstring) is "getting there," but there's still no definitive timetable for his return to game action, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

name: Johnny Furphy
comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

name: Ben Sheppard
comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

name: Brandon Ingram
comment: Ingram (heel/Achilles) will remain on the inactive list for Thursday's game in San Antonio.

name: Bradley Beal
comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

name: Jordan Miller
comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

name: Austin Reaves
comment: Head coach JJ Redick said Reaves' (heel) pregame workout went "well," but he remains without an official timetable to return, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.

name: GG Jackson
comment: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

name: Isaiah Stewart
comment: Stewart (illness) won't play Wednesday against the Cavs.

name: Ty Jerome
comment: Jerome (hip) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game in Cleveland.

name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
comment: Pippen (back) is progressing in his recovery but is still considered week-to-week.

name: Richie Saunders
comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Myron Gardner
comment: Gardner (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.

name: Ryan Rollins
comment: Rollins (illness) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game at Miami.

name: Ousmane Dieng
comment: Dieng will undergo a procedure to repair a fractured left finger Monday, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.

name: Zyon Pullin
comment: Pullin (quadriceps) is listed as questionable for Thursday's game against the Knicks.

name: Jonathan Kuminga
comment: Kuminga (shoulder) is questionable for Thursday's game against the Knicks, Charlie Walton of ZoneCoverage.com reports.

name: Jaylen Clark
comment: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

name: Anthony Edwards
comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

name: Donte DiVincenzo
comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

name: Bennedict Mathurin
comment: Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Detroit.

name: Bryce McGowens
comment: McGowens (elbow) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Detroit.

name: Trendon Watford
comment: Watford (ankle) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Detroit.

name: Trey Murphy III
comment: Murphy (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Detroit.

name: Dejounte Murray
comment: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

name: Alex Caruso
comment: Caruso won't return to Wednesday's game against the Hawks due to right hip soreness, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

name: Thomas Sorber
comment: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

name: Cason Wallace
comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

name: Chet Holmgren
comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

name: Jalen Williams
comment: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

name: Izaiyah Nelson
comment: Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: Jonathan Isaac
comment: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.

name: Noah Penda
comment: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: Paolo Banchero
comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Dean Wade
comment: Wade (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game in Orlando.

name: Tyrese Maxey
comment: Maxey (foot) is out for Wednesday's game in Orlando, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

name: Jaylen Brown
comment: Brown (hamstring) will be re-evaluated at some point this weekend, per Kris Rihm of ESPN.com.

name: Dominick Barlow
comment: Barlow (back) is out for Wednesday's game against Orlando.

name: Adem Bona
comment: Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

name: Ariel Hukporti
comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Mark Williams
comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Robert Williams III
comment: Williams (rest) is listed as out for Thursday's game versus the Bucks.

name: Deni Avdija
comment: Avdija (foot) is listed as questionable ahead of Thursday's game against Milwaukee.

name: Toumani Camara
comment: Camara is questionable to play Thursday against the Bucks due to general soreness.

name: Chris Youngblood
comment: Youngblood (heel) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game at Minnesota.

name: Vit Krejci
comment: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Ja Morant
comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

name: Shaedon Sharpe
comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Maxime Raynaud
comment: Raynaud (knee) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Suns.

name: Ben Simmons
comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

name: Dylan Harper
comment: Harper (hip) won't play in Thursday's game against the Clippers, Jeff McDonald of the San Antonio Express-News reports.

name: Tobias Harris
comment: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

name: Jayden Quaintance
comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

name: Collin Murray-Boyles
comment: Murray-Boyles will not return to Wednesday's game against the Wizards due to an illness, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

name: RJ Barrett
comment: Barrett (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game against the Wizards, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

name: Scottie Barnes
comment: Barnes (injury management) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Washington, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.

name: Kawhi Leonard
comment: Leonard (knee) has progressed in his strength and conditioning program but will miss at least one more week, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

name: Nate Bittle
comment: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet.ca reports.

name: Lauri Markkanen
comment: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Jusuf Nurkic
comment: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Felix Okpara
comment: Okpara (illness) is available for Friday's game against Toronto.

name: Tristan Vukcevic
comment: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Memphis.

name: Reece Beekman
comment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

name: Justin Champagnie
comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

name: Jamir Watkins
comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
